# ankra_mcp_server (Resource)

An MCP tool server registered for the organisation's AI agents. The counterpart of `ankra org mcp-servers add`, `update`, `remove`, `enable` and `disable`. Changes need the `ai.manage` permission. Grant individual tools to roles with `ankra_mcp_tool_grant`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_mcp_server" "sentry" {
  name        = "sentry"
  description = "Error tracking"
  transport   = "http"
  url         = "https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp"
  adapter_key = "sentry"

  # Sensitive values must reference a secret slot or Vault.
  env = {
    Authorization = "$${SECRET_SLOT:3f6a9c1e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}"
  }

  allowed_tools   = ["find_issues", "get_issue_details"]
  permission_tier = "read_only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Server name, unique in the organisation, without spaces or `/`. Changing it re-registers the server.
- `transport` (String) Transport: `http`, `sse` or `stdio`. Changing it re-registers the server.
- `url` (String) Endpoint URL. For `http` and `sse` it must be a public http(s) endpoint; for `stdio` it is only an identifier.

### Optional

- `adapter_key` (String) Curated adapter from `ankra org mcp-servers catalog` this server is an instance of.
- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Tools agent runs may call. Unset allows every tool the server offers.
- `cluster_allow_list` (Set of String) Cluster ids allowed to use the server. Unset makes it available to every cluster.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether agent runs may use the server. Defaults to `true`.
- `env` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables and headers sent to the server. Only the keys you set are managed: keys added outside Terraform (an auth header set in the portal, say) are left alone, and leaving `env` unset touches nothing. A key removed from `env` is deleted from the server. A value under a key that looks sensitive (token, secret, password, api_key, authorization and the like) must be a `${SECRET_SLOT:<id>}` or `${VAULT:<path>}` marker: the platform refuses plaintext there. The values you set are stored in Terraform state (marked sensitive). The platform never returns values, so drift is detected only when a configured key disappears.
- `permission_tier` (String) `read_only` or `read_write`. Defaults to `read_only`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# MCP servers are imported by id. env values cannot be read back.
terraform import ankra_mcp_server.sentry 9a0e7c34-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
